newsitem.title: ESTONIA: -HOIU EXPECTS JOINT EXPANISON INTO BALTIC MARKETS.
newsitem.headline: -HOIU EXPECTS JOINT EXPANISON INTO BALTIC MARKETS.

text.p: Hoiupank deputy chairman Priit Haller said on Thursday that Estonian commercial banks might in the future join forces to expand into neigbouring markets.
"It would be rather normal to join forces to expand outside of Estonia," Haller said in an interview to Raadio 2 on Thursday.
"There have been no concrete negotiations, but the logic says...that if greater efficiency is expected, it is sensible to cooperate with each other rather than to compete," Haller said.
Estonia's leading commercial banks, Hansapank, Hoiupank and Tallinna Pank are all eyeing the Lithuanian market.
Although Hoiupank last week announced it will not concentrate on entering Lithuania at the moment, it is not ruling out the possibility in the future.
